root.title: Deliver practically usable AGI without lowering the achievement bar

prediction.reforecast_rule: If instantiated non-replaced problems exceed the prediction, traverse all active problems, introduce shared/higher-order problems that subsume multiple branches, rewrite affected branches without duplicating completed work, then re-estimate.

rules.selection: Attempt exactly one unresolved leaf at a time unless integration requires a small atomic bundle.
rules.failed_attempt: Decompose the unresolved leaf into child problems whose integration would solve it.
rules.success: Record evidence and move to another unresolved leaf.
rules.parent_resolution: Resolve a parent only after all required children are resolved and integration is verified.
rules.truthfulness: Never mark a capability or AGI achievement as solved without empirical evidence.
rules.separation: The recursive project-management/problem-solving mechanism is not part of the AGI candidate and is excluded from AGI evaluation.

problems.title: Build a general learning and representation substrate
Infer executable symbolic rules and constraints from sparse demonstrations
Filter an explicit executable hypothesis space against sparse demonstrations and expose ambiguity
evidence: 35 local pytest tests passed after integration

problems.title: Generate candidate symbolic programs/rules from demonstrations instead of assuming the hypothesis set is supplied
Scale rule induction and composition beyond a small enumerated program space

history.note: Version-space elimination works only when executable candidates already exist, so open rule induction was decomposed into filtering, candidate synthesis, and scaling/composition.
